source_notes: NWS Karratha Gas Plant operating; federal final environmental approval (Min. Watt, 48 conditions) extends licensed life from 2030 to 2070, granted Sep 2025 (preliminary late May 2025). Status/capacity unchanged — extension is a lifetime matter, not a status change.
scope_note: Representative blue re-verify for the NWS terminal; all five operating units (T1,T3,T4,T5) re-verified operating, T2 retired unchanged.

source_notes: Chevron confirms all three Gorgon trains operating (intermittent maintenance outages are normal, not a status change). Gorgon Stage 3 (Geryon/Eurytion backfill) took FID Dec 2025 — feedgas backfill, not a new terminal/train. Capacity 5.2 mtpa/train unchanged.
scope_note: Representative blue re-verify for Gorgon (T1-T3 operating; T4 cancelled unchanged).

source_notes: Wheatstone operating; periodic weather/equipment outages and restarts through 2025 are operational, not a lifecycle change. Both trains operating, 4.45 mtpa each unchanged.

Pluto Train 2 (5 mtpa, Scarborough feedgas) still under construction; Scarborough Energy Project >96% complete, all 51 modules delivered, targeting first LNG cargo Q4 2026. LatestPlannedStartYear 2026 remains correct. T1 operating unchanged.
scope_note: Representative blue re-verify for Pluto (T1 operating, T2 construction, T3 cancelled unchanged).

source_notes: Ichthys (offshore FPSO/CPF + Darwin onshore trains) operating, ~9.3 Mtpa LNG. INPEX reaffirmed (Mar 2025, Vision 2035) commitment to a third onshore train targeting ~2030 — GEM T3 'proposed' / LatestPlannedStartYear 2030 remains accurate. No change.
scope_note: Representative blue re-verify for Ichthys (T1,T2 operating; T3 proposed ~2030 unchanged).

source_notes: Prelude FLNG operating; intermittent outages/industrial-action history (strike, maintenance) are operational, not lifecycle. Vessel 'Prelude', 3.6 mtpa, Shell-operated unchanged.
scope_note: Representative blue re-verify for Prelude FLNG.
